slides.title: Wiping Rolls at a Glance
slides.lead: Automatic solder paste printers clean the underside of the stencil with a roll of wiping paper, dry or with solvent. Southern Machinery supplies rolls sized for the printers already on your line.
slides.caption: Rolls with different core openings for different printers
slides.notes: Use, solvent compatibility and paste/red glue from listing B text ('清除印刷机钢网、电路板上多余锡膏及红胶', '可配合各种清洁溶液使用'). Dry/wet/vacuum wipe is the printer's cleaning mode; wording kept general.

slides.title: Key Figures
slides.footer: Sizes are written core (tube) length x paper width x roll length, e.g. 410 x 300 mm x 10 m
slides.notes: Brands in market size lists: GKG, Desen, Zhengshi, Nitto, Huancheng, Hetian Gude, DEK, MPM, EKRA, Panasonic, Yamaha, Hitachi, MINAMI (13); JUKI, FUJI, KME, SONY in reference size table. Widths 200-600 mm across listings (140 and 680/850 single listings). MINAMI 15 m in two listings, 10 m in others - to be confirmed.

slides.title: What Poor Under-Stencil Cleaning Causes
slides.lead: Paste left under the stencil is printed onto the next board. The wiping roll decides how much of it is removed, and what it leaves behind.
items: Residue under the stencil spreads onto pads
Weak paper breaks when wet with solvent
Core or opening does not fit the printer
Waiting for the right roll to arrive
slides.notes: Grounded in listing B text: rolls remove excess paste and red glue, keep boards clean, reduce scrap; impurities in the roll cause printing defects; high tensile strength. 'Confirm roll direction and core opening before ordering' from listing I.

slides.title: FAB 1 · Material
rows: Pulp side soaks, polyester side holds
Long-fibre pulp, near zero loose fibre
Less operator time at the printer
slides.notes: All from listing B text and listing E product card. Composition stated as 55% pulp / 45% polyester (E, data sheet A) and 45 / 55 (G, I) - to be confirmed, not shown on slide.

slides.title: FAB 2 · Fits Your Printer
rows: Same core as the original roll
Cross slot, straight slot, 12 grooves, paper tube
slides.notes: Core lengths and openings from listing size lists, E per-brand photos and the reference size table (A i-028). Custom sizes: listings E, I, F.

slides.title: How to Read a Roll Size
slides.lead: Wiping rolls are named by three numbers. The first is the core length, which fits the printer; the second is the paper width; the third is the roll length.
apps: e.g. 410 mm - set by the printer
e.g. 300 mm - set by the stencil area
slides.caption: 410 x 300 mm x 10 m: 410 mm core, 300 mm paper, 10 m roll
slides.notes: Convention verified on listing E roll drawings (管长 / 纸宽 / 纸长) and listing D drawing (core ID 20, OD 23). Roll diameter about 50 mm for 10 m (listing E drawing).

slides.title: Core Openings by Printer
slides.notes: Openings from listing E per-brand renders and the reference size table. DEK: table says straight slot one or both ends; one listing sells a cross slot that also fits straight-slot holders - confirm with the customer's old roll.

rows: SMT stencil wiping paper roll (under-stencil cleaning roll)
Two layers: pulp side and polyester side

Low lint, absorbs water and oil, high tensile strength
Use dry or with stencil cleaning solvents
Core length x paper width x roll length
10 m standard; 15 m on some sizes
Plastic Ø 19.5 / 20 mm or paper tube by brand
Cross slot, straight slot, 12 inner grooves, paper tube
Width-only rolls; 200 x 200 mm sheets, 10 per pack
slides.notes: Listing B text (material, structure, properties, solvents, anti-static packing), D i-058 (plain / mesh), H (PP mesh), size lists, G (sheets), J (width-only). Basis weight 56 g/m2 (J) vs 60 ± 3 g/m2 (A data sheet) and thickness 0.35 mm (A data sheet) are to be confirmed - not shown.

slides.title: How to Order the Right Roll
slides.lead: Five details let us match your printer. A photo of your old roll's core end settles the opening.
steps: Brand and model, e.g. DEK, GKG G9
Measure the old core, e.g. 410 mm
Photo of the old roll as it sits
slides.notes: 'Confirm roll direction and core opening before ordering' (listing I). Roll direction is not defined in any source - ask for a photo of the old roll mounted or as removed.
